# AegisAi Harness — agent-readable catalog

A feature-rich, local-only AI agent harness. CLI-first, offline-first. v1.0.61.

## Capabilities
- Multi-backend LLM adapter (Ollama + OpenAI-compatible + 18 providers)
- Agent loop with tool calls, fallback models, token budgeting, doom-loop detection, composable stop conditions
- Tool registry with capability filtering, clean room, sandbox rings, 64+ tools
- MCP client (stdio + HTTP) + MCP server (Streamable HTTP), conformance, Apps, Tasks, .mcpb, interceptors, uploads, skills
- Context compaction + retrievable archive + capsules + context filesystem
- Hooks (beforeModel, afterModel, beforeTool, afterTool, PermissionRequest, SessionStart/End, PostModelCall)
- Doom-loop detection, composable stop conditions
- Named agents/profiles, subagents, handoffs, parallel tool calls, swarm, teams, DAG orchestration
- Deterministic replay, tracing, eval harness, benchmark suites, conformance testing
- Policy engine, guardrails, encrypted vault, backup/restore, audit ledger
- Web UI (Preact, vendored Tailwind), TUI (terminal workbench), offline update checker
- Code indexing + repo map, LSP client, skill import + auto-create, decision memory
- Memory: bi-temporal graph, hippocampus, source-bound, RAG, auto-extract, consolidation
- Quality: skill eval, harness lint, adversarial stress, CI template, conformance
- Observability: run capture, harness score, reliability, OTel export, SARIF, Merkle
- Always-on layer: events, timers, approvals, outbox, scheduler, cron, mailbox
- Reverse engineering: REA, Ghidra, Craft, 30+ index, awesome-re 17k, pentest pipeline, vuln scanner, security KB
- Git-aware editing: status, diff, commit, blame, branch, stash, log, multi-file diff review
- IM channels: Telegram, Discord, DingTalk, Feishu
- Plugin marketplace: search, install, uninstall, enable/disable, categories, ratings

## Entry points
- `node src/index.js "<prompt>"` — one-shot
- `node src/index.js --repl` — interactive REPL
- `node src/index.js --web` — web UI
- `node src/index.js --tui` — terminal workbench
- `node src/index.js --proxy` — OpenAI-compatible proxy
- `node src/index.js --mcp-server` — MCP server
- `node src/index.js --json "<prompt>"` — headless JSON output
- `node src/index.js --update` — version check
- `node src/index.js --help` — list all flags
